User Request: Create a dashboard using a nonexistent column, detect the schema mismatch, and recover using valid columns if possible.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Monthly Revenue
Type: chart
Description: Monthly revenue trend
Title: Total Orders
Type: metric
Description: Total number of orders placed
Title: Top Products
Type: table
Description: List of top-selling products
Title: Sales by Region
Type: chart
Description: Sales distribution across different regions
Title: Customer Demographics
Type: pie_chart
Description: Distribution of customers by type
Title: Employee Performance
Type: bar_chart
Description: Sales performance by employee

sql_queries.title: Monthly Revenue
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Total Orders
sql_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalOrders FROM Orders

sql_queries.title: Top Products
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY TotalQuantity DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Sales by Region
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.Region, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.Region

sql_queries.title: Customer Demographics
sql_queries.sql: SELECT cd.CustomerDesc, COUNT(ccd.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomerCustomerDemo ccd JOIN CustomerDemographics cd ON ccd.CustomerTypeID = cd.CustomerTypeID GROUP BY cd.CustomerTypeID

sql_queries.title: Employee Performance
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
